author: reek
body: Stage 3 of NoAliasCodegen: a store through a freshly constructed record narrows cache invalidation to that base alone, because virgin bump-allocator memory is provably disjoint from every earlier cached base. Freshness dies the moment the pointer is read as a value, so the alias probe below must take the full-flush path: if narrowing wrongly survived the alias bind, the stale cached read shifts the output.
